Name: Kit's Sebastian
Author: asarigolo
Description:
hewwo apparently i can only make shit when i'm either sick or severely sleep-deprived. a friend made the mistake of mentioning her desire for long-haired seb this morning and i immediately opened paint tool sai. goodbye

configurable, either in the config file or through generic mod config menu. first option turns on/off the entire mod, the others turn on/off the hair, lips, blush, earrings, and chokers, all separately (greasemonkey seb has a different choker, configurable separately from the tattoo choker of the normal outfits. beach outfit doesn't have a choker).

now w green eyes!!! vanilla is the default, the options are [b]OliveSprite[/b] (based on his sprite, name color self-explanatory), [b]RobinSprite[/b] (based on his mother's sprite eyecolor. a much bluer green than olive's), [b]RobinPortrait[/b] (you can guess; a bit lighter and less blue and saturated than the precedent option), [b]KitsChoice[/b] (the lightest option, greyish-green. not actually kit's choice bc she likes to stick to canon so she picked olive but her favorite kind of green eyes), and [b]AsarisChoice[/b] (the author's. it's me. the coldest and darkest option, because i wanted something closer to his vanilla eyes).

will i update this? possibly
[s](kinda wanna make every option not dependent on the long hair, so you can get the piercings or the choker for example w his normal length hair, but i'm gonna fucking faint rn so i'm not doing it now <3)[/s]
(woke up at 4am so i'm still so fucking damn tired yeehaw but i did it!! next on the list is sprite edit bc kit wants me to and who am i to say now to the m'lady. also editing the choker again bc it looks goofy on the left. probably some other shit, i don't know)
